in_sanskrit.name: अर्येश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A person who is noble and rules or governs.

in_hindi.name: अर्येशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: A person who is the best or superior and rules or governs.

in_tamil.name: அர்யேஷா
in_tamil.long_meaning: A person who is noble and has good conduct or character.

in_telugu.name: అర్యేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: A person who is noble and has good conduct or character and is the ruler or leader.

in_marathi.name: Aryesha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aryesha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Arya’ which means noble and ‘Isha’ meaning God or ruler. This name is bestowed upon a girl born to noble and virtuous parents. In Hindu mythology, Aryesha represents the goddess of wisdom and knowledge.

This name is bestowed upon a girl born to noble and virtuous parents. In Hindu mythology, Aryesha represents the goddess of wisdom and knowledge.
